items.observation: `matchAsPrefix` calls the eager `allMatches(input, start)` although it needs only the first match; allMatches scans the whole input and builds a list. `String.startsWith(re2)` does an unnecessary full scan on long input.
items.proposed_fix: A private `_matchAt(input, bytes, position)` helper making a single `re2Match` call; firstMatch, allMatches and matchAsPrefix use it. A test showing the result is unchanged on long input with many matches.
items.closure_criteria: matchAsPrefix, firstMatch and allMatches share a private _matchAt helper that makes a single re2Match call. A test on long input with many matches shows unchanged results.

items.observation: The 'encodeWtf8 -> allocateBytes -> setAll -> try/finally freeBytes' skeleton appears in eight places; firstMatch and allMatches duplicate the slot allocation.
items.proposed_fix: A `_withNativeText<T>(String, T Function(Pointer<Uint8>, int))` helper; slot allocation in a single private function.
items.closure_criteria: All native-text call sites route through a single _withNativeText helper and the match slot allocation lives in one private function.

items.observation: Compilation error messages are read with `utf8.decode`; every other text path uses `decodeWtf8`. If an RE2 diagnostic echoes a pattern fragment, unpaired surrogate bytes can make `utf8.decode` throw; the effect was not exercised.
items.proposed_fix: `decodeWtf8` (or `allowMalformed: true`) + a test with an invalid pattern containing an unpaired surrogate.
items.closure_criteria: Compilation error messages are decoded with decodeWtf8 or utf8.decode with allowMalformed: true. A test with an invalid pattern containing an unpaired surrogate produces the FormatException message.

items.observation: The dispose dartdoc counts the throwing methods but omits replaceFirst, replaceAll and matchAsPrefix (these also throw StateError). The Re2Set.matches comment says 'First call learns the count' but there is a single call.
items.proposed_fix: Fix the dartdoc and the comment.
items.closure_criteria: The dispose dartdoc lists replaceFirst, replaceAll and matchAsPrefix among the methods that throw StateError and the Re2Set.matches comment describes the single call accurately.

items.observation: The format step does not cover `tool/`; tool/redos_chart.dart and tool/redos_figure.dart sit outside the format check.
items.closure_criteria: The format step in .github/workflows/ci.yaml includes tool and the files under tool/ pass the format check.

items.observation: The UTF-16 width step (`length == 4 ? 2 : 1`) is written separately in `_Utf16Cursor.toUtf16` and `_utf16IndexToByteOffset`.
items.closure_criteria: _Utf16Cursor.toUtf16 and _utf16IndexToByteOffset both call a shared private _utf16Width helper.

items.proposed_fix: Enter it in the debt register; a periodic security-fix scan. The upgrade brings an Abseil dependency and is separate, planned work.
items.closure_criteria: The debt register records the 2022-06-01 RE2 pin and a periodic security-fix scan. Any upgrade lands as separate planned work that notes the Abseil dependency.
